.env.example.purpose: Template for all environment variables (DB URL, JWT secret, EMAIL_ENABLED, OVERDUE_THRESHOLD_DAYS, MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB)

Dockerfile.purpose: Python 3.12 slim image build for the API

docker-compose.yml.purpose: API + postgres services; postgres on host port 5433, internal db:5432

pyproject.toml.purpose: Project metadata, dependencies, and tool config (lint/format)

alembic.ini.purpose: Alembic configuration pointing at app.db.session URL resolution

README.md.purpose: Setup, run, seed credentials (DEV ONLY), and endpoint overview

app/main.py.purpose: FastAPI app factory: routers, exception handlers, health endpoints, startup wiring

app/seed.py.purpose: python -m app.seed; creates admin@example.com / resident@example.com demo accounts (DEV ONLY)

app/core/config.py.purpose: Pydantic Settings: env loading, DB URL, JWT secret/TTL, EMAIL_ENABLED, OVERDUE_THRESHOLD_DAYS default, MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB

app/core/security.py.purpose: argon2 password hashing, PyJWT encode/decode, OAuth2PasswordBearer tokenUrl /api/v1/auth/login

app/core/exceptions.py.purpose: Domain exceptions mapped to {detail, code} error responses

app/core/dependencies.py.purpose: get_db session dependency, get_current_user, admin role guard

app/db/base.py.purpose: Declarative Base with UUID PK mixin and UTC timestamp conventions

app/db/session.py.purpose: Sync engine + SessionLocal factory from settings

app/models/__init__.py.purpose: Import all models for Alembic autogenerate

app/models/user.py.purpose: User model (uuid PK, unique email, role, is_active)

app/models/category.py.purpose: Category model (unique name, is_active soft delete)

app/models/complaint.py.purpose: Complaint model with FKs, enums, resolved_at, and all five indexes

app/models/complaint_history.py.purpose: Append-only history rows, FK CASCADE to complaint, index complaint_id

app/models/notice.py.purpose: Notice model with is_important index and composite (is_important, created_at) index

app/schemas/complaint_history.py.purpose: History read schema (status, actor, note, created_at)

app/schemas/settings.py.purpose: System settings read/update schemas incl. threshold validation 1..365

app/api/router.py.purpose: Aggregates all route modules under /api/v1 prefix

app/api/routes/complaints.py.purpose: POST multipart create, filtered list, get/status/priority/history endpoints

app/services/complaint_service.py.purpose: Complaint CRUD, lifecycle transitions + history, filters/sort/pagination, admin ordering, immutability of RESOLVED

app/services/notice_service.py.purpose: Notice CRUD, importance ordering, creation-time email trigger

app/services/notification_service.py.purpose: Post-commit background email dispatch; log-only when EMAIL_ENABLED=false

app/services/storage_service.py.purpose: Storage abstraction; local impl under uploads/complaints/ with UUID names, MIME whitelist, size cap

app/services/overdue_service.py.purpose: Dynamic overdue flag computation using overdue_threshold_days setting

app/services/settings_service.py.purpose: system_settings get/set with overdue threshold validation (1..365)

alembic/env.py.purpose: Alembic environment wired to app settings URL and model metadata

alembic/versions/0001_initial_schema.py.purpose: Initial migration: users, categories, complaints, complaint_histories, notices, system_settings + indexes

tests/conftest.py.purpose: Creates/drops smt_test database, sync engine/session fixtures, auth client fixtures

tests/test_complaints.py.purpose: Lifecycle transitions, immutability, ownership 404, photo upload tests

tests/test_complaint_filters.py.purpose: Filtering, sorting, pagination, admin ordering tests

docs/knowledge-graph.json.purpose: Single source of truth: project, locked decisions, entities, relations, services, routes, waves, status

docs/index.json.purpose: Repo path -> purpose/owner_wave map for navigation across context compaction
